description: Source code for the EdgeRDDImpl class in Apache Spark's GraphX module, implementing edge RDD operations such as map, filter, join, persistence, and checkpointing.

classes.name: EdgeRDDImpl
classes.description: Implementation of EdgeRDD with methods for persistence, transformation, and join operations on edge data in GraphX.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the partitionsRDD for debugging and visualization.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects all edges into an array.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the partitionsRDD at a specified storage level.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Removes the persisted partitionsRDD from memory/disk.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Persists the partitionsRDD using the target storage level.

methods.name: getStorageLevel
methods.description: Returns the current storage level of the partitionsRDD.

methods.name: isCheckpointed
methods.description: Checks if the partitionsRDD has been checkpointed.

methods.name: getCheckpointFile
methods.description: Returns the checkpoint file path if available.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the total number of edges.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Applies a function to the edge values.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters edges based on edge triplet and vertex predicates.

methods.name: innerJoin
methods.description: Joins with another EdgeRDD based on edge data.

methods.name: mapEdgePartitions
methods.description: Applies a function to each edge partition.

methods.name: withPartitionsRDD
methods.description: Creates a new EdgeRDDImpl with a given partitions RDD.

methods.name: withTargetStorageLevel
methods.description: Creates a new EdgeRDDImpl with a specified target storage level.
